items.title: Over a Noetherian local ring of the base, purity along a fibre coincides with universal purity
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file flat.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that when the local ring of the base at a point is Noetherian, purity of a finite type module along the fibre is equivalent to universal purity along that fibre (statement lines 4927-4934). The proof localizes the base at the point, so that the Noetherian impurity lemma applies, and translates between purity and the absence of impurities using characterization (2) of purity. The reduction and the translation are the substance, so the claim is H2.
